chapter: Jelly Roll's road trip, Benny Carter and Chick Webb
title: Benny Carter introduces four-part saxophone harmony
summary: Carter wrote four-part sax harmony in 1929-30, which changed the roles of banjo and guitar players who had only played triads.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now -- okay, so back to Benny Carter.
You were talking about four-part harmony.

Yeah. Benny Carter, he was great. He started that four-part harmony in 1929, 1930, which was, you know, just about unheard of. It just came into style, and like I said, about piano players and banjo and guitar players and whatever, you know, it was a complete turnaround because before that they were just playing triads mostly, played triads.
